text:
Okay, you have to listen because this is the weirdest thing ever. So, remember how everyone was complaining about the dry, brown grass and how the creek looked like a sad, cracked sidewalk? Well, yesterday was supposed to be the last day of that big drought. Mom said we had to fix the old stone well in the backyard before it got too hot again.

I went out with my bucket, right? It felt heavy just carrying it. I started pulling up the rope, hand over hand, expecting to hear that loud *splash* sound or see clear water. But when I looked into the dark hole, something glowed. Like, really bright orange glowing.

I lowered the bucket slowly, super careful so I wouldn’t drop it. When it hit the bottom, it didn’t make a splash. It made a *clink*. A metallic clink! I pulled it back up, shaking a little bit because my hands were sweaty. Inside wasn’t water. There was a tiny, shiny coin. Just one! And next to it, a weird blue marble that hummed against my palm.

It’s not fair, right? We needed water for the flowers and for drinking, but the well gave us treasure instead. I showed Dad, and he looked scared, not happy. He said some things are better left buried. But I don’t care. I put the marble in my pocket. It feels warm, like it’s alive. Do you think it’s magic?
